statement: Annotated from the Beinecke scan alone (full page and horizontal strips). Four rows, each opening with a red cylindrical jar at the left margin that carries a label written on it, followed by detached roots and plant parts with short labels beside their stalks; the fourth row holds one whole plant with a long striped root, green heart-shaped leaves and two hanging clusters. Label lines were paired with objects from the line ids and unit codes only: the single container-label line of each row to its jar, the remaining label lines of the row to the objects left to right (row 1: the upper line of nine first, then the three lower objects). Row 1 has one two-line label (f99r.6 and f99r.7) beside the fifth upper object. Rows 2 and 3 each have eight labels for seven objects, so one label in each row (f99r.25, f99r.34) could belong to either neighbour; I recorded them as nearby labels and the pairing around them may be shifted by one.
